item.title: OpenPhantasie - Version 1.3 released
item.description: A new open-source engine for SSI's Phantasie Series (I–IV)​ has been released. What is OpenPhantasie?​ OpenPhantasie is a ground-up recreation of the game engine, written in C# using MonoGame. It brings all four games together under a single interface, with a common set of options and a consistent experience....
